decisions.reason: The fifteen-day program is cheap to run and close to the core business, but it has little visible commitment and overlaps with express line D, so folding it into D remains a real possibility even though management keeps it for now.
The European-approved exterior door was launched publicly at BAU, carries sunk certification costs and completes the core Teckentrup 62 system, so the firm will persist with it.

The multi-model express line has a dedicated page and anchors the firm's fast-delivery positioning, and after B was dropped it is the main vehicle for that commitment, so management will stick with it.
The digital platform represents substantial development investment and is central to the announced direction of deeper service, so any weak uptake would be read as a temporary ramp-up issue.
